intent: Count the reads per gene for this RNA-seq sample (liver_rep1.bam, single-end 50 bp, aligned with a splice-aware aligner to the genome the annotation belongs to). The library was prepared with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA protocol (dUTP second-strand marking), and the gene counts will go into DESeq2.
silent_error: htseq-count's --stranded option defaults to 'yes' (documented in 'htseq-count --help' and the HTSeq counting docs: default yes), i.e. read must map to the same strand as the feature. A dUTP/TruSeq-stranded library is reverse-stranded: almost every read maps to the strand opposite to its gene, so with the default nearly all reads fall into __no_feature and every gene ends with a count near 0 (here 2 of 98 reads counted) instead of the real counts. htseq-count exits 0, prints only 'N GFF lines processed / N alignment records processed', and the table has the normal shape, so nothing names the strand mismatch. The clean run uses --stranded=reverse.
